title: 四种机器数对照：原码/反码/补码/移码
expected_output:
=== 8-bit machine number representations ===
   value   original   ones    twos    biased
       0     00      00    00      80
       1     01      01    01      81
       5     05      05    05      85
     127     7F      7F    7F      FF
      -1     81      FE    FF      7F
      -5     85      FA    FB      7B
    -127     FF      80    81      01
    -128     --      --    80      00

notes:
  original and ones-complement have TWO zeros (00 and 80)
  twos-complement has exactly ONE zero; 80 means -128, NOT negative zero
  ones-complement of -127 is 80 -> that is the negative zero artifact
  biased code = twos-complement with the sign bit flipped
  twos range -128..127: one more negative than positive
